claude.rationale: The realized record shows structural continuity: "All of the vessels have been transferred to Euronav NV in 2018," the acquired vessel-owning subsidiaries were liquidated in 2019-2020 as an orderly consolidation, and four Gener8-associated entities remained 100%-owned Group entities through YE2022 — no documented product/operations incoherence realized over time (p4=0). No documented operations-vs-organization fracture appears; the only continuing dispute (RMK Maritime advisory-fee claim) is a third-party fee matter tied to the 2016-2017 merger advisory, not an internal operations/culture breakdown (p5=0). No segment-specific financial scalar, divestiture, write-down, or bankruptcy attributable to the former Gener8 fleet is disclosed.
